page_title: MCI 1-1 EVE | Manchester City v Everton 26/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Phil Foden (Manchester City) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
90+3' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Idrissa Gueye (Everton) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90+2' What a big chance! Rico Lewis (Manchester City) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
90+1' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.

90' A lofted cross from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out for a corner. Manchester City can continue in their attacking effort.
90' Seamus Coleman will be replaced by Nathan Patterson (Everton).
87' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
87' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
86' 22:7 – the total goal attempt statistics.
86' The Manchester City players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
85' Here is a change. Nathan Ake is going off and Pep Guardiola gives the last tactical orders to Jahmai Simpson-Pusey (Manchester City).
85' Substitution. Ilkay Gundogan (Manchester City) in, Mateo Kovacic out.
84' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a low pass into the box, towards Erling Haaland. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
83' Jack Harrison (Everton) takes the corner but it's cleared.

83' Orel Mangala (Everton) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. Everton have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
81' Today's match ends for Iliman Ndiaye who will be replaced by Jesper Lindstrom (Everton).
80' The free kick is delivered by Phil Foden (Manchester City) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
79' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Orel Mangala (Everton) for his blatant foul.
77' Erling Haaland receives a sweet cross inside the box from Savinho (Manchester City), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
76' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
75' Pep Guardiola has decided to make a change. Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) replaces Jeremy Doku.
75' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) tackles a bit over-zealously and Simon Hooper blows for a foul.
74' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City).
71' The foul by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) was seen by Simon Hooper who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
70' Sean Dyche prepares a substitution. Dominic Calvert-Lewin is replaced by Armando Broja (Everton).
69' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

69' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. The ball is out of play and Everton manage to earn a corner.
68' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
67' Savinho (Manchester City) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
64' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
64' The linesman signals that Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
61' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) hammers the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked by an opposition player.
60' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) wins the ball from the corner kick and strikes. The effort lacks accuracy and goes miles wide of the left post.
60' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
60' Savinho (Manchester City) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play. Manchester City win a corner kick.
57' The corner from Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) is hurriedly cleared.
57' Abdoulaye Doucoure is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton). Now Everton have a corner.
56' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
53' A goal, which was scored by Erling Haaland (Manchester City), was disallowed due to offside.

53' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) places the ball on the penalty spot and sends it towards the bottom left corner. His effort isn't powerful enough, allowing Jordan Pickford to dive and keep the ball out with an excellent save.
52' Seamus Coleman (Everton) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
52' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

51' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Simon Hooper stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. It's a penalty! Great chance to score for Manchester City!
51' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
50' A pass into the box finds Savinho (Manchester City) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Jordan Pickford denies him.
50' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City).
49' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
47' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
47' A short through ball almost allows Savinho (Manchester City) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders. Manchester City win a corner.
46' The whistle blows and Simon Hooper starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) fails to connect properly with the corner kick and plants his header way over the bar from the centre of the box.
45+1' Jack Harrison (Everton) steps up to send the ball in.
45+1' Jack Harrison (Everton) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Everton earn a corner.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Jordan Pickford leaps to intercept the corner kick from Phil Foden (Manchester City).

45' He should have scored! Phil Foden (Manchester City) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block. Manchester City will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
44' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
43' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
43' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
42' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
42' Referee Simon Hooper sees the trip by Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Manchester City win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
41' Savinho (Manchester City) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
40' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

36' 1 - 1 Abdoulaye Doucoure sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top right corner. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
36' A cross from Seamus Coleman (Everton) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
35' Savinho (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
33' Phil Foden slides a brilliant pass into Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), but his shot from inside the box goes a whisker wide of the right post.

32' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Simon Hooper blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Manchester City win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
30' Savinho (Manchester City) creates himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot which is blocked by a defender.
28' Chance! Idrissa Gueye (Everton) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the top of the net, but Stefan Ortega is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
27' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) takes the corner which is cleared.
27' Seamus Coleman (Everton) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Everton will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Jordan Pickford displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Erling Haaland (Manchester City) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
24' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Nathan Ake (Manchester City) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
23' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner.
23' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.

21' Orel Mangala (Everton) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.

19' Phil Foden (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Everton.
19' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simon Hooper blows for a foul. Manchester City earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Jeremy Doku plays it to Bernardo Silva (Manchester City), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Jordan Pickford. 1:0.
12' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.

10' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Manchester City are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
9' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Everton will have a goal kick.
5' Savinho (Manchester City) creates space for himself in the box and shoots, but the effort is unwittingly blocked by one of his own teammates.

4' Savinho (Manchester City) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score into the bottom right corner, but great anticipation by Jordan Pickford allowed him to make a comfortable save.

3' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball glanced away off the left post!
3' Phil Foden (Manchester City) takes the corner with a short pass.
3' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
2' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
1' The first half has just begun.
Everton will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simon Hooper.
